title: Discount
description: Discount rule or promotion that can be applied to orders. Tracks discount code, type, value, eligibility requirements, usage limits, and expiration.

code.description: Unique discount code or identifier used to apply the discount

type.description: Type of discount (e.g., percentage, fixed_amount, buy_one_get_one)

value.description: Discount value - percentage (5-100) or fixed amount depending on type

minimum_purchase.description: Minimum order value required to qualify for this discount

max_uses.description: Maximum number of times this discount can be redeemed

used_count.description: Current number of times this discount has been used

expires_at.description: Date when the discount expires and is no longer valid
